--- title: scales --- `scales` The registry of spatial scales (``geo/scales.yaml``). ## Functions | Name | Description | | --- | --- | | [ancestors](#geo4bolivia.scales.ancestors) | Coarser scales a unit of ``scale`` nests in, in breadth-first order. | | [scale_of](#geo4bolivia.scales.scale_of) | The scale a geo ID belongs to, from the ID patterns (e.g. a municipality ID -> ``"municipality"``). | | [scales](#geo4bolivia.scales.scales) | All registered scales, keyed by id. | | [table](#geo4bolivia.scales.table) | The registry of spatial scales as a table, one row per scale (``geo.scales()``). | ### ancestors { #geo4bolivia.scales.ancestors } ```python scales.ancestors(scale, ref=None) ``` Coarser scales a unit of ``scale`` nests in, in breadth-first order. Administrative scales follow ``parent``; a scale whose units are unions of ``scale`` units (a grouping, such as statistical regions) is also an ancestor. The parent chain of each level comes before the groupings of that level, e.g. ``municipality -> [province, department, country]``. ### scale_of { #geo4bolivia.scales.scale_of } ```python scales.scale_of(geo_id, ref=None) ``` The scale a geo ID belongs to, from the ID patterns (e.g. a municipality ID -> ``"municipality"``). ### scales { #geo4bolivia.scales.scales } ```python scales.scales(active_only=False, ref=None) ``` All registered scales, keyed by id. ### table { #geo4bolivia.scales.table } ```python scales.table(active_only=False, ref=None) ``` The registry of spatial scales as a table, one row per scale (``geo.scales()``). Columns: ``label``, ``kind`` (admin, grouping, grid, custom), ``parent`` (the coarser scale it nests in), ``children``, ``id_pattern``, ``example`` and ``status`` (active or planned). ``active_only=True`` hides planned scales. ## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example} ```python !pip install -q geo4bolivia import geo4bolivia as geo import plotly.express as px geo.scales() # ids, labels, parents, ID patterns ``` ::: {.g4-example-links} [Open a blank Colab notebook to run it](https://colab.research.google.com/notebooks/empty.ipynb) ::: ::: {#4be5ed4b .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
